facts.fact: WARDIP reports the government approved the Regulamento Nacional de Interoperabilidade de Sistemas e Plataformas Digitais dos Servicos Publicos e Privados by Decreto n.o 27/2025 (a decree), published in the Boletim Oficial of 31 October 2025; it states the regulation lets public entities share information securely, without saying they are obliged to.
facts.system: Decreto n.o 27/2025 - Regulamento Nacional de Interoperabilidade

note: No statement that public bodies are obliged to share or that the decree has been applied, so no duty fact.
